scope: Independent nominal headless Isaac: newly trained PPO plus frozen v3 gain0.2 controller. Paired repeatability evidence, not ROS validation or statistical significance.

controller_contract.correction_position: after original core step, before original IK and guards
controller_contract.correction_coordinates: instantaneous TCP tangent plane; not unqualified baseXY
controller_contract.projection_basis: private unit TCP normal after proper-rotation validation; original core inputs untouched
controller_contract.gate_measurement: same-tick action force/tracking snapshot; raw input arithmetic only for standalone replay
controller_contract.disabled_output: hard gates and zero correction return original entire core output object
controller_contract.soft_release: reason2 only: old correction decays with tau0.08, no new error correction; epsilon1e-6mm
controller_contract.soft_release_step_bound: old_norm*(1-exp(-dt/tau))+epsilon plus measured tangent reprojection adjustment
controller_contract.telemetry_semantics: eligible/active qualify new tracking; releasing/soft_releasing decay old tracking; applied=active|releasing
controller_contract.gate_scope: extra correction eligibility only; original mode/contact switches remain unchanged
controller_contract.baseline_comparison: PPO versus constant Mode6 under this same controller variant
controller_contract.deployment_status: not installed or connected to ROS
